column12: Notes
No T&C/VAT on site. SIC is VAT-exempt sector (residential care, Group 7 Sch 9 VATA) - likely genuinely not registered, not a failure.

abcmoney.co.uk found but likely NOT a match - site claims founded 2012 and is a financial news publisher, while company 11390108 was incorporated 2018 in Llanelli, Wales, with no registration details linking it to the site. Treating as coincidental name match. No VAT confirmed for 11390108. Companies House: annual accounts overdue since 2023, confirmation statement also overdue - strong signal of dormant/abandoned company.

davdanenterprise.co.uk exists but invalid SSL cert (NET::ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID) and content brands itself as 'Holistic Health Solutions' with no company name/number/VAT/address - looks like generic template content, not a verified official site for this company. Treating as no confirmed website. Registered address is First Floor Swan Building, 20 Swan Street, Manchester M4 5JW - a known mass company-formation/virtual office address (shared by dozens of unrelated companies), confirming no real physical presence - consistent with shell/small company genuinely below VAT threshold. SIC is VAT-exempt-adjacent sector (health activities).

VAT GB309240133 belongs to a sister company, Lord Kitch Limited (11644494, property trading) - confirmed via HMRC, not our target Lord Kitch Management Limited (13730304). A SQL search of our Companies House database confirms only these two 'Lord Kitch' entities exist, confirming it's a real, separate entity, not a data error. Not a confirmed VAT match for our target company; likely Lord Kitch Limited is the VAT-registered trading entity for the building, while our target handles residents' service charges - typically outside VAT scope.

No own website found. VAT GB944521132 found via search but ruled out - its address (Redbourne, Gainsborough) matched neither the company's registered office (Caistor) nor the director's correspondence address (Petersfield), and no ICO registration existed for it. CompanyData.com, matching directly on company number 10399697, explicitly confirms: 'not recorded as VAT-registered.' Companies House: fully compliant (accounts and confirmation statement up to date) - active small consultancy, not a dormant shell. SIC not VAT-exempt, so no-VAT is a threshold/small-turnover case.

Website confirmed via exact company number match (7468383) in footer. VAT GB103354850 found via Endole Open, then independently confirmed via official HMRC VAT checker: registered business name 'RACHEL ANDERSON CONSULTING LIMITED' at 'Sakura, The Avenue, Medburn, Newcastle, NE20 0JD' - matches exactly the company's current registered office. Fully confirmed VAT match.

No own website found - search only returns unrelated similarly-named firms (The Ecology Consultancy, Ecology Consulting Ltd, etc.), different company numbers. Registered address 'Office 20566, London E6 2JA' - typical virtual office/mail-forwarding format, suggests no real physical presence. Companies House: accounts/confirmation statement up to date. SIC not VAT-exempt, so no-VAT is likely a threshold/small-turnover case.

pavfixers.com found - exact name match, London-based, business is rainscreen cladding/SFS/facades, consistent with SIC 43390. However no company number or full address on site, so not conclusively tied to 07376659 (initial search had missed it, only found directory listings). VAT GB137451515 found via Endole Open, then independently confirmed via official HMRC VAT checker: registered business name 'PAV FIXERS LTD' at '7 Wells Gardens, Dagenham, RM10 8HD' - matches exactly the company's registered office. VAT match fully confirmed regardless of website ambiguity.

Trades as 'Yellow Door Photography' / 'Graham Lee Photography' - confirmed via ICO register trading names, consistent with SIC 96090 (other service activities). Registered address is Teachers House, Hardwick, Buckinghamshire - officially HP22 4DU per Companies House, but yellowdoorphotography.co.uk shows HP22 4DZ (a one-letter postcode typo on the company's own site) vs gleephotography.co.uk's T&Cs page showing the correct HP22 4DU. Good reminder: even a company's own published data can contain errors, so cross-check against Companies House/ICO rather than trusting a single source, especially where a single character differs between sources. VAT GB198427950 found on 'Terms & Conditions - Graham Lee Photography' (https://www.gleephotography.co.uk/terms-and-conditions-2/), independently confirmed via official HMRC VAT checker: registered business name 'GRAHAM JAMES LEE LTD' at 'Teachers House, Hardwick, Aylesbury, Buckinghamshire, HP22 4DU' - matches exactly Companies House registered office.

No own website found - only a differently-numbered similarly-named firm (Law Chambers Solicitors Ltd, 13762509) turns up, unrelated. No SRA (Solicitors Regulation Authority) registration found under this name, unusual for a genuine practicing solicitor firm. CompanyData.com, matching directly on company number 09181797, confirms: 'not recorded as VAT-registered.' Endole profile shows no VAT listed either, plus all financial assets/liabilities reported as GBP 0, only 1 employee, no website/phone/email on file - strong dormant/shell signal despite the 'Solicitors' SIC code.

column9: Yes - HMRC confirmed (Ltd/Limited abbreviation only difference)
column12: VAT GB869464075 found via Endole Open, registered business name 'R W EVANS & SON LTD' at 'Unit 8B, Brecon Enterprise Park, Brecon, Powys, LD3 8BT', matching exactly the company's registered address. Cross-checked against the official HMRC VAT checker: HMRC shows the name as 'R W EVANS & SON LTD' (abbreviated), while Companies House has the full legal name 'R W EVANS & SON LIMITED' - same company, cosmetic abbreviation difference only, not a mismatch. Good illustration for the automated-matching discussion: a naive exact-string match would flag this as 'no match' even though it's the correct company - matching logic needs to normalize Ltd/Limited (and similar suffix variants) before comparing, or it will under-count valid VAT matches as false negatives. No own website found.

Website/directory listing confirmed - exact address match (48 Main Street, Skidby, Cottingham, HU16 5TG) and FCA Registration Number 1027287 shown, confirming a genuine regulated financial advisory firm, not a shell. No VAT number disclosed. Financial/insurance intermediation and investment advice are largely VAT-exempt under UK law (Group 2 Schedule 9 VATA), so absence of VAT here is plausibly a genuine sector exemption rather than a below-threshold case, though newly incorporated (Jan 2025) also fits a small-turnover explanation.

Website confirmed - trades as 'HES Renewables' (solar/battery storage installer), phone number and address match exactly between the company's own site and its RECC (Renewable Energy Consumer Code) membership listing, plus MCS/NICEIC accreditations - genuine operating company, not a shell, despite the generic 'Holding companies' SIC code (likely a default picked at incorporation, not reflective of actual trade). No VAT number shown on site or RECC listing. Solar/renewable installation is a taxable supply (not VAT-exempt, though some energy-saving materials qualify for reduced rate), so no-VAT is likely a below-threshold case given the company was only incorporated in 2022 (micro entity).

No own website found, and initial read (no CQC listing found, non-care SIC code) wrongly suggested a shell. Endole showed VAT GB211753536 and revealed the company is part of Cinnamon Care Homes Group (9 companies, international owner) - a real operating care group, not a shell. Cross-checked against the official HMRC VAT checker: registered business name 'HEXTABLE CARE HOME LTD' matches exactly. HMRC shows a different address (Garden Floor, 2 Kensington Square, London W8 5EP) than the Companies House registered office (Egham, Surrey) - explained by centralized VAT group registration at the parent group's address, common for multi-entity care home groups, not a mismatch/false-positive like the Lord Kitch case (there the NAME itself was wrong; here the name matches exactly, only the address differs for a structural reason). Good illustration that a registered-office/VAT-address mismatch isn't automatically disqualifying - has to be checked against corporate group structure before treating as a red flag.

No dedicated website found. Registered address is The Fairfield Centre, St David's Place, Maesteg, CF34 9LR - a real, named community building in Bridgend, not a mass-formation address, but no charity registration found under this exact name (checked Charity Commission register) and no listing under Bridgend Council's own community hubs page. Likely a small vehicle set up to hold/operate a single community building. Letting/operating real estate is normally VAT-exempt unless the landlord has 'opted to tax' (common for commercial landlords, less so for small community operators) - combined with the likely small/local-community scale, no-VAT plausibly reflects genuine sector exemption or a small non-commercial operation below threshold, though this is a lower-confidence read since the organisation's actual activity couldn't be directly confirmed.

No dedicated website or salon listing found under this exact name. Endole confirms: Active/Micro, London, incorporated Oct 2022, no VAT number shown (unlike e.g. Hextable's Endole page, which does display VAT when registered - absence here is informative, not just a gap). Notable flag: 'Compulsory strike-off was discontinued 6 months ago' - company was on track for involuntary dissolution (usually for filing non-compliance) and it was reversed, plus declining cash, negative net assets and high debt ratio, no turnover reported. Consistent picture: small, financially struggling micro company, plausibly genuinely below the VAT threshold rather than a discovery failure - though the near-strike-off is also a mild dormant/marginal-viability signal worth flagging alongside the threshold explanation.

column6: No own website - confirmed via UK Food Hygiene Rating register + Facebook page
column12: No own company website, but confirmed as a genuinely trading shop via the official UK Food Hygiene Rating register (business 'Caviar Fresh Fish,' 51 Whitley Street, Reading, inspected April 2026) plus a matching Facebook page. VAT GB407333029 found via Endole (directly tied to company number 13965824, not an ambiguous name-only match), then independently confirmed via the official HMRC VAT checker: registered business name 'CAVIAR FRESH FISH LIMITED' matches exactly. HMRC shows the VAT address as Flat 7, Daisy House, 68 Honey Bee Street, Calcot, Reading RG31 7ES - a third address, different from both the Companies House registered office (Staines-upon-Thames) and the trading shop (Whitley Street, Reading), but geographically consistent with the business (same Reading area) - most plausibly the director's actual residential/correspondence address used specifically for VAT registration, not a mismatch. Three different addresses across three sources for one small company is a useful illustration that address alone is a weak matching signal; name + company number is what actually confirms identity. Note: fresh/raw fish is zero-rated for VAT (0%), not exempt, so a small shop trading above threshold registering for VAT is unsurprising. Data-quality footnote: Companies House filing history shows the company was originally registered as 'CAVIAR FRESH SISH LIMITED' for 9-15 Mar 2022 (6 days) before being corrected to 'FISH' - a typo at the official source itself, not a rebrand, but a reminder that even Companies House bulk data can contain errors at the point of registration.

Revised from initial 'no VAT' read: the group's own Terms & Conditions page explicitly states 'Registered Office Cruden Investments Ltd, 16 Walker Street, Edinburgh... Registered in Edinburgh SC044986. VAT registration number: 268991200' - names the exact target entity by name AND company number, the strongest possible identity match (not just name or address alone). Confirmed via the official HMRC VAT checker. So the earlier 'holding companies are typically outside VAT scope' reasoning was directionally right in general but wrong for this specific company - Cruden Investments Ltd evidently does make taxable supplies (e.g. property/management services within the group) and is VAT-registered. Good caution for the README: a plausible structural explanation (holding co -> likely outside VAT scope) is not a substitute for actually checking - it should lower confidence in a 'not found' verdict, not replace verification. Data-quality footnote: the T&Cs page lists the postcode as EH14 3HN, while Companies House/Endole show EH3 7LP for the same address - another small discrepancy at an official-looking source, though the company number match removes any doubt about identity here.

enchantedarcade.com found - exact name match, indie video game studio (games like 'The Cascadier'), consistent with SIC 62011 (software development). However no company number, VAT, or registered address shown anywhere on the site (checked homepage), so not conclusively tied to 15860087 - same ambiguity pattern as PAV Fixers, name/business-type match only. No VAT found. Indie game studios are typically very small (often single-founder/self-published), so no-VAT is plausibly a genuine below-threshold case. Endole confirms registered office as Flat 18, Roma Corte, 1 Elmira Street, London SE13 7GP - a residential flat, no VAT shown there either - reinforces the single-founder/home-registered-small-company picture, raising confidence slightly (Low-Medium to Medium).

Strongest possible confirmation: the company's own website has a Legal Notice page listing company number NI630076 AND VAT number 208341433 together, plus the exact registered address (138 Belmont Road, Belfast BT4 2AQ) - a single source ties name, company number, address and VAT all at once. Also cross-checked via the official HMRC VAT checker independently: name and address match exactly. Also listed in a Belfast/NI business directory (4ni.co.uk) at the same address. Fully confirmed VAT match on every axis. Methodology footnote: this is a Northern Ireland company (NI-prefixed number, separate NI Companies Registry from GB's), but UK VAT rules apply uniformly across GB and NI for services (only goods trade with the EU has separate NI Protocol/Windsor Framework arrangements) - so the VAT-discovery approach doesn't need to change for NI-registered companies, unlike company-number handling which does.

No website found under this exact name. A plausible-looking match, mandacarsleeds.co.uk ('M. & A. Cars (Leeds) Limited'), turned out on checking to be a DIFFERENT company - number 07291042, registered in Oldham, not 08698425/Leeds - same city, same sector (used cars), similar but not identical name; confirmed as a false lead, not our target, so ruled out rather than left ambiguous. Registered office for our actual target is 42 Colwyn Road, Leeds LS11 6LP - a residential-street address, consistent with a small independent used-car trader/lot. No VAT found, and previously checked for EORI (no result - not a goods-import business). Used-car dealers commonly use the VAT Margin Scheme (VAT on profit margin only) once registered, but that doesn't change whether registration itself is required - independent used-car trading is a common small/sole-trader-scale sector, so below-threshold is plausible, though confidence stays low given no confirmed website/trading evidence specifically for 08698425.

No dedicated website (typical for a single-asset property SPV, not a consumer-facing business). Registered office 100 Victoria Street, London SW1E 5JL - a known corporate-services/professional-formation address, not an operating address; has previously had a registered charge (secured lending), consistent with a property investment vehicle. Notably renamed twice: '50 Annes Gate (No.1) Limited' (2001-2004) to 'LS Lionheart Limited' (2004-2015) to current name (2015-) - classic pattern for an SPV renamed to track whichever asset it currently holds. Endole blocked on fetch (403, rate-limiting pattern again). No VAT found. Genuinely uncertain rather than a confident guess: letting of commercial real estate is VAT-exempt by default UNLESS the landlord has 'opted to tax' the property (common for prime commercial real estate near Tottenham Court Road, to reclaim input VAT on refurbishment) - both a genuine exemption and an undiscovered opted-to-tax registration are plausible here, and the entity's scale (large secured property asset) makes 'below threshold' unlikely, unlike most other no-VAT cases in this sample.

No website found under this exact name. Registered office 29 Alumbrook Avenue, Holmes Chapel, Crewe CW4 7BX - a residential address, consistent with a small/sole-practitioner consultancy. Incorporated Feb 2020. No VAT found. Nuance worth flagging: the 'health activities' SIC alone doesn't imply VAT exemption - UK VAT exemption for medical/health services (Group 7 Sch 9 VATA) covers actual clinical care provided by registered health professionals, not business/management consultancy sold TO the healthcare sector, which is a normal taxable supply. So unlike e.g. Midway Transitional Solutions (residential care), this is more likely a below-threshold case than a genuine sector exemption, given both the small scale and the consultancy (not clinical-care) nature of the service.

No website found, no group/parent identified despite searching - unlike Cruden Investments, no independent site names this entity as part of a larger recognisable group. Registered office 'The Managers Office, 65 The Old Gaol, Abingdon OX14 3HE' - a corporate-services/professional-formation-style address, not a real trading premises. No VAT found. Deliberately marked Uncertain rather than defaulting to 'holding companies are usually outside VAT scope': the Cruden Investments case earlier in this sample showed that assumption can be wrong (Cruden Investments turned out to be VAT-registered despite the same SIC code and initial holding-company reasoning). Without independent evidence of what this specific entity actually does, a structural explanation can't be safely applied here - genuinely don't know if it's a dormant/small SPV (below threshold or no taxable supplies) or an active investment vehicle that simply wasn't found.

Strongly confirmed as a genuine, currently operating pharmacy: own website (kiampharmacy.com), GPhC (General Pharmaceutical Council - the official pharmacy regulator, equivalent to CQC for care homes) registration number 9012618, and Companies House registered office - all three independently show the exact same address (13 Worple Road, Epsom, KT18 5EP). Superintendent Pharmacist named (Zeynab Fallah, GPhC 2076826). Incorporated only Jan 2025 - a brand-new business, plausibly still below the VAT threshold given its short trading history. No VAT number found. Nuance: pharmacies have mixed VAT treatment - dispensing NHS/private prescriptions is zero-rated, but over-the-counter retail sales are standard-rated - so this isn't a clean sector exemption case like residential care, it's a threshold/newness case for a business that will likely need to register once turnover grows.

Valuable case for the 'keeping the dataset current' debate topic: confirmed as a real healthy-fast-food shop at 118 Melton Road, West Bridgford (address matches Companies House exactly), opened Jan 2023, part of a small local 'Crunch' brand (founder also behind Crunch Mansfield). Local news (West Bridgford Wire, Aug 2025) confirms the physical shop CLOSED, with the operators saying they want to 'step back, reconsider our strategy.' However, Companies House still shows the company as fully 'Active' with no overdue filings (next accounts due Jan 2027, confirmation statement Oct 2026) - a live illustration that a company can be legally active and fully compliant on paper while its actual trading premises has already shut down. No VAT found. Genuinely uncertain whether this reflects below-threshold (a small single-shop operation) or the shop simply never got VAT-registered before closing - can't distinguish from available evidence, and the company's 'live' status in bulk data is already stale relative to its real-world trading status.

column6: 192.com directory listing (no dedicated own website found)
column12: No own website, but confirmed via a 192.com business directory listing ('Brookesport Limited - Sports Clubs') at 71 Holly Bush Lane, Hampton, TW12 2QY - matches the Companies House registered address exactly. Note: a similarly-named but different company, 'BROOKESPORT LTD' (08468289), also exists - checked and ruled out, our target is 11850525. Residential-looking address, small scale, consistent with a single-coach/small sports coaching business rather than a large club. No VAT found. Sporting services supplied by commercial (non-'eligible body') providers are standard-rated for VAT - the exemption under Sch 9 Group 10 VATA applies only to qualifying non-profit sports clubs, which this doesn't appear to be - so below-threshold, not sector exemption, is the more likely read here.

Confirmed genuine, currently operating business via its own website (explorezanzi.com, describes itself as a 'registered and fully licensed tour company' running tours/safaris in Tanzania and Zanzibar) plus independent Tripadvisor reviews of real trips. No company number or VAT shown on the site itself. Companies House registered office: Hawthorne House, 17a Hawthorne Drive, Leicester LE5 6DL (residential-looking), incorporated Aug 2023. Interesting cross-border case for the 'Beyond the UK' angle: a UK-registered company whose actual service (tours) is delivered entirely outside the UK, in Tanzania. UK tour operators typically fall under the Tour Operator's Margin Scheme (TOMS), and margin-scheme travel services enjoyed OUTSIDE the UK/EU are zero-rated under TOMS - so this company could be VAT-registered with no VAT actually charged/visible, or could genuinely be below threshold, or could be treating its supply as largely outside the scope of UK VAT. Marked Uncertain rather than defaulting to below-threshold, since the international/TOMS angle is a third possible explanation this sample hasn't seen elsewhere. Site's own 'Financial Security' page adds a key detail: it describes itself as 'a Tanzanian-accredited travel agency based in Nungwi (North Zanzibar)... fully licensed tour operator,' with its head office given as 'Jumba La Train, Darajani, Zanzibar' - i.e. the actual operating business identifies itself as Tanzanian, not British. This suggests the UK Ltd (15049551) may function mainly as a UK-facing booking/marketing entity, with the substantive tour operation and local tax/licensing sitting with a separate Tanzanian business - which would mean UK VAT registration may genuinely not apply to most of the economic activity at all, not just be 'not found.' A good illustration that for internationally-delivered services, the UK company number alone doesn't tell you where the taxable activity actually sits.

Strongly confirmed as a genuine, real organisation via multiple independent sources: own website (describes itself as a non-profit educational organisation working with young artists with autism/learning disabilities), a published book ('We Were There, Now We're Here'), a University of Exeter research project page, and Council for Disabled Children membership listing - well-documented, legitimate small arts/education social enterprise, not remotely a shell. Registered address (per directory listings) is Gosditch House, 5 Gosditch Street, Cirencester, Gloucestershire. Company's own site did not show company number/VAT (Companies House direct fetch was blocked this time). CIC (Community Interest Company) legal form restricts profit distribution but does not itself grant VAT exemption - exemption would depend on specific activity type (e.g. formal education/cultural services by an 'eligible body'), which isn't clearly established here. Given the small, grant/project-funded-looking scale of this organisation, below-threshold is the more likely read than a formal sector exemption, though genuinely not confirmed either way.

column6: dogstuff.co.uk (site exists but could not be fetched to confirm ownership - DNS/robots error)
column12: Naming trap identified and NOT resolved: a website dogstuff.co.uk exists ('DogStuff | Dog Products | Local Dog Grooming'), but a DIFFERENT company, 'DOGSTUFF.CO.UK LIMITED' (03579024), held that near-identical name and was DISSOLVED in 2017 - years before our target 'DOGSTUFF LTD' (12555744) was incorporated in 2020. Could not fetch the live site (robots/DNS error) to check which entity, if either, currently operates it - genuinely unresolved, not assumed either way. Registered office for our target is 82 Mere Brow Lane, Preston PR4 6JP (residential-looking). No VAT found for 12555744. Flagged as Uncertain/low-confidence rather than guessing a website match, given the clear precedent in this sample (Lord Kitch, M A Motors) of similarly-named-but-distinct companies causing false positives.

No website or independent listing found under this exact name - search only surfaces unrelated 'KSC Marketing' businesses in Germany and Brazil. Registered office 39 Russell Road, Newbury RG14 5JX (residential-looking). No VAT found. Data-completeness note: Companies House itself lists THREE SIC codes for this company (70229 management consultancy, 73110 advertising agencies, 74100 specialised design activities), while our sample export only captured one (70229) - a reminder that bulk/snapshot exports of Companies House data can under-represent a company's registered activities, which matters for any sector-based VAT-exemption reasoning built on SIC alone. No independent confirmation of current trading activity found at all (unlike most other 'no VAT' cases in this sample, which had at least a directory listing or CQC/GPhC-type registration) - marked Uncertain/low-confidence rather than assuming below-threshold, since it's not established the company is genuinely trading.

No website found. Could not independently verify company details via automated fetch (both Companies House and Endole returned 403/rate-limit errors on my end - worth noting as a reliability observation for Part 3, since even the official government source isn't always accessible on a given attempt). User independently checked Endole directly and confirmed no VAT number is shown there either - so the 'no VAT' finding itself is confirmed, just not the surrounding company details (address, status, etc.), which stayed unverified. Old company number (03xxxxxx range, likely incorporated mid-1990s) suggests a long-running small firm; name plausibly implies a historical UK-Gulf trade/property agency link, but this is speculation. Given the long incorporation history without any VAT ever surfacing across two independent lookups, below-threshold (a small, long-running property management agency) is a more grounded read than a bare 'Uncertain,' though confidence stays low given the otherwise thin evidence base.

Two naming traps identified and ruled out for this one company - a record for the sample's dead-ends section: (1) oneillpr.com ('O'Neill Properties, Ltd.') is a Texas, USA company (Midland, TX address, US phone), unrelated. (2) oneillproperty.co.uk ('O'Neill Property,' Glasgow/Edinburgh letting agent) is a genuine UK business, but Scotland-registered (SC-prefixed company numbers turn up for several 'O'Neill Property' variants - SC733692, SC815231, SC222827 - none matching); our target's NI-prefixed number means Northern Ireland incorporation, a different jurisdiction/registry entirely, so this is also ruled out. No genuine website found for NI061938 itself - a very common surname/name combination. Endole page exists but repeatedly blocked on fetch (403/rate-limit); user independently confirmed via direct access that Endole shows no VAT for this company. No VAT found. Letting/operating real estate is VAT-exempt by default unless opted to tax (same nuance as LS Tottenham Court Road, #22), but without confirming the entity's actual scale, can't tell if this is exemption, threshold, or discovery failure - marked Uncertain rather than guessing.

No dedicated website found, but confirmed via Endole as Active, registered at 6 Claremont, Bradford BD7 1BQ - notably structured as 'private limited by guarantee without share capital,' a legal form typically used for non-profit/community/membership organisations rather than standard profit-driven companies, consistent with a community bereavement/burial services body (Bradford has a large British Pakistani/Muslim community; the director's name and 'burial council' search hits suggest this may serve faith-specific burial needs, though not independently confirmed). No VAT found. This is a genuinely strong sector-exemption case: UK VAT law exempts 'burial and cremation' services under Sch 9 Group 8 - services related to the disposal of the dead are exempt from VAT for qualifying providers, unlike the funeral director's other retail add-ons (coffins, flowers) which can be standard-rated. So no-VAT here is well-supported both by the legal structure (guarantee company, not typically VAT-registered for trading margin) and by the specific statutory exemption for this exact sector.

No website found. 'ECI' plausibly stands for 'Early Contractor Involvement' - a genuine construction-industry term (pre-construction consultancy input from a contractor) - consistent with the registered SIC codes (43999 specialised construction, plus 82990 other business support services). Personal-name-style company (director likely = Paul Walker), residential address (6 Willow Walk, Kinsley, Pontefract WF9 5LZ), incorporated 2017. No VAT found. Pattern consistent with a sole-consultant/small contractor practice - below-threshold plausible, though confidence stays low given no independent confirmation of current trading activity beyond the bare Companies House record.

Very different profile from the rest of the sample: confirmed via Wikipedia (citing 'Companies House extract company no SC221290' directly) as CityFleet Networks, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Singapore-listed ComfortDelGro, a major London ground-transportation/chauffeur/black-cab operator - formerly a JV with Cabcharge Australia (fully ComfortDelGro-owned since 2017). Publishes a public 'Tax Strategy' page (UK legal requirement only for large groups, Finance Act 2016) - independent confirmation of scale. Own T&Cs page (cityfleet.co.uk/terms-and-conditions) confirms VAT is contractually charged on bookings (clause 4.2.1) but doesn't list the number itself. VAT GB775069400 found via vat-lookup.co.uk AND independently corroborated on Endole too (same number, tied to the same company), then independently confirmed via the official HMRC VAT checker: registered business name 'CITYFLEET NETWORKS LIMITED' at '31 Colville Road, London, W3 8BL' - fully confirmed VAT match. Companies House registered office (verified directly, not just inferred from the SC prefix) is '139 C/O Azets, Quay 2, 139 Fountainbridge, Edinburgh EH3 9QG' - a 'care of' address at Azets, an accountancy firm, a common pattern for companies whose registered office is administrative only, separate from where the business actually operates (here, London per HMRC and the VAT address). Three different addresses across three sources (Companies House/Edinburgh-via-accountant, HMRC VAT/London, and presumably operational sites across the city) - not a discrepancy worth treating as suspicious given the strong independent identity confirmation already established, but a good example that a registered-office address alone tells you little about where a company (especially a larger one) actually trades. Methodology note: user searched the entire cityfleet.co.uk site directly and could not find the VAT number published anywhere on it, despite this being a large, well-resourced corporate operator - a reminder that even sizeable legitimate companies often don't publish their VAT number on public-facing pages (it typically only appears on actual invoices), so 'own site has no VAT shown' should never be read as a negative signal about VAT registration status, and third-party/regulatory cross-referencing stays necessary regardless of company size.

No website or independent listing found under this exact name - search only surfaces unrelated similarly-worded companies ('Intensive Engagement,' 'Body Engagement,' etc.). Registered office 41 Pearse Close, Penarth, Wales CF64 1TH - a residential address. Incorporated 2020. No VAT found. No confirmation of what the business actually does beyond the generic SIC ('other amusement and recreation activities') - marked Uncertain/low-confidence rather than assuming below-threshold, since current trading activity couldn't be established at all.

No website found under this exact name - search only surfaces unrelated similarly-initialed consultancies (J&V Consulting, V J V Consultancy, LJ Cost Consultants, LYNIV Consulting). Two candidates checked, neither confirmed as a match: ljconsults.com ('LJ Consultants,' US-oriented, no UK company number) and ljconsults.co.uk ('L-J Consulting,' UK domain, run by someone named Lucy per the contact email - but offers startup/business strategy consulting, not IT/computer facilities management, a sector mismatch against our target's SIC, and no company number shown to confirm identity either way). Companies House blocked on fetch (403, see PROJECT_BRIEF's bulk-vs-live-access note). No VAT found. No independent confirmation of current trading activity - marked Uncertain/low-confidence rather than assuming below-threshold, consistent with how other unconfirmed cases (KSC Marketing, Energetic Engagements) were treated.

No website or directory listing found for this exact company number. This is a personal-name company (director's surname 'Murfin' is the company name), and search results were dominated by other unrelated Murfin-surnamed people and companies (Andrew Murfin Limited, Murfin Motor Company, a US drilling company, several healthcare professionals named Murfin on LinkedIn/BACP) - none confirmed as connected to 15152096 specifically. Deliberately did not pursue broad personal-name searching to try to identify the individual behind this company, consistent with the ethics/sourcing principle logged in PROJECT_BRIEF (debate topic 4) - company-number-scoped lookups came up empty, and going further into general people-search territory wasn't judged proportionate for a single ambiguous small-company record. No VAT found. User independently confirmed the same: no presence on Endole or anywhere else checked - the company exists only as a bare Companies House record, no other footprint found at all.
